content: Our model keeps role consistency between pre-training and fine-tuning by connecting two encoders for ST task. However, this leads to some new problems: 1) The text encoder consumes $\mathbf {e^s}$ during MT training, while it accepts $\mathbf {h^s}$ during ST training. However, $\mathbf {e^s}$ and $\mathbf {h^s}$ may not follow the same distribution, resulting in the semantic inconsistency. 2) Besides, the length of $\mathbf {h^s}$ is not the same order of magnitude with the length of $\mathbf {e^s}$, resulting in the length inconsistency.
